subject: Pilot runway: packaging options (timebox vs. bucket) and short extension
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@opswell.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot runway — quick packaging question and short extension ask

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the support during our pilot — the workloads have been stable and our ML team is ramping up new prompts. We have two quick asks as we approach the end of the 30-day timebox:

1) The team is worried about hitting a hard cutoff. Would Redwood consider a 2–3 week runway extension to finish a final accuracy sweep?
2) We’re also evaluating packaging: keeping the original timeboxed window (days left) vs. switching to a small pre-paid token bucket for the remainder (so we can do heavier burst tests).

From our side, a short extension with a modest discount would be ideal. If a bucket is easier operationally, we can pre-pay ~50k tokens and finalize evaluation metrics.

I attached a usage export showing our last 4 days. Can you loop in pricing/legal if needed?

–Asha
Asha Patel
Head of AI Platform | Opswell
asha@opswell.ai
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — quick packaging question and short extension ask

On Sun, Apr 11, 2027 at 9:02 AM Asha Patel <asha@opswell.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the support during our pilot — the workloads have been stable and our ML team is ramping up new prompts.

Hi Asha — appreciate the heads-up and the export. Quick notes:

- We can do either approach (timebox extension or token bucket). Operationally the token bucket gives you burst flexibility; the timebox extension is simpler from contract standpoint.
- For a short runway (2–3 weeks) we can offer a 20% pilot discount on applicable usage or convert that discount into a 1:1 credit against committed pricing if you decide to go dedicated later.

Would you prefer (A) 21-day extension at 20% off, same per-token pricing, or (B) 50k token bucket prepaid with a 15% discount and no extension? If you choose B we’ll invoice the bucket and keep it available for the remainder of the original window + 21 days.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (pricing) and Jonas (technical) to confirm there are no gating security/legal steps. I’ll draft a short addendum once you confirm which option you prefer.

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Opswell ask — discount bands and conversion guardrails

Priyom / Jonas — quick internal note before we send the addendum:

- 21-day extension at 20% is within standard sales play for pilot continuity; acceptable to approve from a discount governance POV. Mark as one-off pilot concession tied to signal/success metrics (latency/accuracy thresholds).
- If they take the 50k bucket with 15% discount, include clause: unused tokens expire at the end of the 21-day runway and are non-refundable, but can be applied to future committed purchase within 90 days if they sign a Dedicated deal (credit applied at list price).
- Ask Legal to keep the addendum limited (1 page) and avoid changing data residency/SOC clauses.

Jonas — can you confirm there are no infra/ops blockers for enabling bucket usage across regions? Also confirm we can do token expiry as described.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

- No region gating for a 50k token bucket; we can scope the bucket to their existing run region (us-west-2) and enable burst routing to other compatible instances if needed.
- Token expiry and credit-for-commit logic is supported by our billing engine; will need to flag in the addendum.

Hi Asha — thanks for the usage export. Based on internal approvals we can proceed with either path. TL;DR of the two options we can execute today: 

Option A — 21-day extension
- 21 additional calendar days added to your current pilot window
- 20% discount applied to any incremental usage during extension
- Simple one-page addendum (attached: redwood_pilot_addendum_v1.pdf)
- Success metrics: we’ll flag a pass/fail on the final sweep (accuracy delta and throughput) to make conversion conversations faster

Option B — 50k token prepaid bucket
- 50,000 tokens prepaid at 15% discount; bucket usable immediately for burst testing
- Bucket validity: remains available for the remainder of current window + 21 days; unused tokens expire thereafter
- If you convert to Dedicated within 90 days, unused tokens can be applied as credit against first invoice (applied at list price)

We can get the addendum signed today for A or an invoice out for B within the day. Attached I’ve included a draft addendum and I’ve also pulled your recent usage export (Opswell_Pilot_Usage_Export.csv) into the thread.

Which do you prefer? If helpful, Jonas and I can set a short 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the bucket behavior.

Best,
Priyom
